lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to collect IPC classification data across Mauritania's administrative units. The spatial data was compiled into geographic datasets representing different food insecurity scenarios for the January 2022 near-term projection period, with classifications standardized according to the IPC framework.
